individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A contains super-resolution localization/density map reconstructions, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B contains super-resolution localization/density map reconstructions, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell shows individual gray dots for each cell alongside the mean ± SEM.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes shows individual gray dots for each cluster alongside the mean ± SEM.
Scatter/dot plot of percentage of molecules in clusters shows individual gray dots for each cell alongside the mean ± SEM.
Panel F contains super-resolution localization/trajectory reconstructions, not a plot of averaged data.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution shown directly) and bottom is a line plot of MSD per trajectory; neither is a bar chart of averages requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph, not a plot of averaged data.
